reviewItem.question: If an exposed environment does nothing about "Implement the new v1alpha1 Operation controller by @negz in https://github.com/crossplane/crossplane/pull/6594", what happens, and is that review or action? proposed: none

consequence.statement: The v1alpha1 Operation controller is newly available and does not affect existing configurations or workloads that do not explicitly use it.

proposed.statement: A new v1alpha1 Operation controller is implemented and available in Crossplane 2.0.0.
